## Description

Lifts non-linear multi-factor equity risk exposures into linear dynamical spaces using Koopman operator dictionary expansions, tracking portfolio factor drift and style rotations accurately.

## Where it may fit

Systematic equity factor investing, style rotation tracking, multi-factor risk attribution.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Equity Funds, Systematic Factor Investing Desks.

## Required data

Fundamental factor panels, daily stock return matrices, style factor benchmark returns.

## Caveats

Observable dictionary expansion requires L1 regularization to avoid overfitting factor drift.
